{{Top|leg}}
'''Penladen Hills''' was an area on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], reachable up the [[Solleu River/Legends|Solleu River]] from the capital [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. It was the site of the [[Penladen detention camp]] during the [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]], writer of ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', eventually cut any mentioning of Penladen Hills in the final product. The hills were later made [[canon]]ical in the [[StarWars.com]] blog post [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'': Author's Cut, Part 6 — Showdown at Naboo'']].
